UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Represents a user profile of the simulation

lastActive.description: When the user last interacted with the app

CustomCharacter.title: CustomCharacter
CustomCharacter.description: Represents a user-created story character definition

id.description: Unique identifier of the character definition

shortDescription.description: Short bio hook or role of the character

definition.description: Detailed narrative background definition or vector DNA

userId.description: UID of the user who owns the character

createdAt.description: When this custom character was instantiated

GameSave.title: GameSave
GameSave.description: Represents a narrative snapshot save slot

id.description: Unique identifier for the save slot

name.description: Custom user-provided name for this save slot

timestamp.description: When this save slot was written

messages.description: The current timeline story dialogue history

playerCharacterId.description: The currently active player POV character id

gameMode.description: Active story game mode: standard or free-will

activeCharacterIds.description: The currently selected active cast ids

openRouterModel.description: Active OpenRouter model name if active

userId.description: The UID of the user who owns this save slot

/users/{userId}/customCharacters/{charac.description: The custom roleplay characters defined by this user

/users/{userId}/saves/{saveId}.description: Saves and checkpoints created by this user
